data.summary: The diff is a client-side theming change (Tailwind dark classes, ThemeToggle, theme.js helpers, a pre-paint inline script in Layout.astro, chart colours). No security regression found. The only untrusted input is the localStorage 'theme' value, which is validated against an allow-list (light/dark/system) and only drives classList and style.colorScheme, never HTML or script sinks. There are no new dependencies, secrets, network calls, or HTML-injection sinks.
